verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering advisory and legal services, not a software platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is outside its product category. The evidence shows only legal services and simple online resources such as an investor-readiness check and cap table downloads. Nothing in it shows a job-scheduling or workflow-automation capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
